reviewedRevision: abbf9c9 plus the fixes in this commit
independentProbes: 1,440 fuzz runs with 3.87M simulation steps over all 30 floors, solo and co-op, at 30-144 Hz with hostile dt and pointer values: no exception, non-finite value, wall embedding, unsupported grounding or damage without a nearby hazard. A prompt-following bot cleared 296 of 300 floor runs. Mutation spot-checks on the new tests killed 12 of 13 mutants.

findings.observation: Power-up help said speed, range and heavy snow last until you are hurt; they expire after 15 s. The texts are now built from RULES and tested.
Bounce wording was off by one; balls break on the 4th hit, heroes included.
A ball pinned between a hero and a wall was placed inside the wall; it now shatters.
An unreachable Furnace Queen spawn branch was removed.
Terminal assertions were conditional. New unconditional tests cover an idle loss in EN and ZH, a floor-30 win and a store that throws.
A throwing progress store crashed createGame or a floor clear; both calls are now guarded.
The floor menu prompt named only keys; it now says a tap on a floor starts it (a first rewording that claimed a second tap was itself caught and corrected).

openNotes: No test proves a shot dies at a wall face before its range ends; the reviewer's 42,385-sample probe found the game correct.
Falling balls can clip a tile next to a vent slot by up to 3.2 px (cosmetic).
Powers and the shield expire without a warning blink.

browser.method: Official Claude in Chrome extension, local server; real clicks on Start, the language switch and the touch buttons, synthetic in-page keys; only DOM text and the canvas were read.
observed: Chinese: Start opened floor 1; Right, X and Up changed the prompt line and moved the hero; the description shows the corrected bounce text.
English 390 px phone frame (371 px inner, no horizontal overflow): real taps on Left, Jump and Snow moved the hero and flipped the prompt arrow.
The console showed no errors or warnings during either session.
